methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: the PG2E solution comes into play upstream, facilitating the initial identification of a relevant scope for deploying an EMS.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Tool for selecting an ISO 50001 certification scope; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised.

paper_type.evidence_quote: PG2E is an innovative, fully digital solution that uses a combinatorial approach to automatically identify the ISO 50001 certiﬁcation scope based on monthly or annual energy consumption data and the deﬁnition of substitute criteria

stage1.notes: PG2E selects an EMS/certification scope upstream; it does not construct or evaluate an EnPI or energy baseline.
